summary: Round-2 prelaunch review of the attempt02 frozen snapshot identified by manifest SHA256 a06e3c95… (integrity.json reports the same digest; this is not a clean-commit review). All six round-1 findings are resolved on inspection of the code and frozen evidence. SG-001: plan.BUDGET_SECONDS totals 9540 s (<3 h) and is derived from the now-frozen predecessor runs.csv (4-BD/bounce16 loops 61.18 s and 62.30 s; job 44870463 elapsed 34m43s in accounting.psv); lifecycle.job_end_time reads SLURM_JOB_END_TIME or a bounded squeue %e lookup and fails closed on a non-future value; launch.ensure_time is called before qualification (600), each GPU test (300), each staging pass (1800, matching the 1800 s stage_deadline), each probe (300) and each case (900), always requiring ceiling+300 s; a refusal or any exception writes campaign-status.json partial_not_accepted with the operation and completed cases, runs cleanup, and exits nonzero without complete.json or audit.json. SG-002: copy_checked copies and re-hashes in 8 MiB blocks checking a stop event and deadline between blocks; a worker exception sets stop before the pool's with-block joins all workers; the SIGTERM handler sets stop and raises SystemExit; jf_raw_cache runtime.sh execs Python so the sbatch trap's TERM reaches the launcher. SG-003: cleanup_stages produces an independent receipt per medium, continues after one failure, and launch raises on incomplete cleanup only when no exception is already propagating. SG-004: the 036 hardware.json from job 44770441 is in the manifest; its PCI records for 0000:c4:00.0 and 0000:c5:00.0 read numa_node "5", current_link_width "4", current_link_speed "16.0 GT/s PCIe", and nvme3/nvme0 at those addresses report model "SAMSUNG MZQL27T6HBLA-00A07" firmware GDC5602Q, while nvme1/nvme2 are the 960 GB system drives; lsblk shows nvme0n1+nvme3n1 forming md0 raid0 on /lscratch, matching storage.qualify's two-leaf raid0 gate. SG-005: scheduler.json (11:33:30 PST) shows sdfampere036 IDLE with AllocTRES empty, no reservation covering 036, the lcls:data@ampere association with normal QOS and no GrpTRES/MaxTRES limits, yet sbatch --test-only still predicts a 2026-11-30 start; this is unexplained and recorded as a limitation, not a validity blocker. SG-006: README documents the checkout-sourced jungfrau_calibration example as unused harness provenance. The rest of the harness is unchanged in design from round 1 and re-verified: rank masking precedes runtime/MPI/CUDA imports; placement is PCI-ordered, UUID-only and cross-checked against cupy PCI ids and psana peer counts; exact event/bytes/read/histogram/batch/stream/drain gates; cold gate after DataSource setup; leaf-only NVMe accounting and physical NIC RX gates; traced pilots only; owned process groups stopped before owned-stage removal; 30-case matrix identical to plan.matrix(); resources match run.sbatch. Evidence: junit-frozen.xml shows 56 tests, 0 failures/errors/skips, run against attempt02/source on sdfiana025; the earlier junit.xml with 11 setup errors is a missing basetemp directory, not a code failure. Three new low, non-blocking findings concern status reporting only. Verdict: pass for launching the diagnostic as the sole authorized job; allocation-time GPU acceptance, storage qualification, pilots and per-measurement audits remain inside the job by design.

limitations: Static read-only review: no commands, tests or hashing were executed. The manifest digest a06e3c95… is taken from integrity.json and the supplied manifest text; attempt02/manifest.json itself is outside the permitted read roots and was not read.

The native compatibility receipt at sim10-kvikio-bounce-20261113/attempt01/native-compatibility.json and the pinned PR source were not re-read this round; verify_manifest and audit gates over them were reviewed as code only, consistent with round 1.

Baseline helpers (support, cpu_plan, hardware, task_evidence, network_watch, runtime, host_memory, bulk_accounting, task_runtime, prepare_runtime) were spot-checked for the signatures used by the new code rather than fully re-read; round 1 reviewed them in full and the README states they are frozen unchanged.

No live multi-GPU/NVMe execution exists. Allocation-time GPU acceptance (31 tests per GPU), storage qualification, free-space check, six traced pilots and per-measurement cold/I-O audits are inside the authorized job by design and were assessed only as code.

Scheduler eligibility is unresolved: sbatch --test-only predicts a 2026-11-30 start for an IDLE node with no covering reservation and no visible association/QOS limits. This cannot be investigated read-only. Refresh immediately before submission, report pending honestly, and do not fall back to another node or resource shape.

The walltime budget relies on sdfampere018 Weka measurements; 036 Weka and NVMe rates are unmeasured. The in-job deadline guard makes a slow run partial_not_accepted rather than killed, but a partial matrix is still possible.
The hardware constants are from the 2026-11-13 receipt for 036; a live topology change will be caught by the fail-closed gates but would consume the exclusive allocation before any measurement.

findings.evidence: After the try/except/finally, `audit(output)` runs outside any handler. If audit() raises after a fully completed campaign, complete.json exists with status pass but no campaign-status.json is written at all (the except block only covers the campaign phase), so the only signals are the nonzero exit and the Slurm stderr traceback.
findings.requested_change: Wrap the audit call so that an exception writes campaign-status.json with a status such as audit_failed_not_accepted (and the error) before re-raising, so the results directory is self-describing.

findings.evidence: `operation` is last set to 'gpu-tests-3' before fixture validation, stage directory creation, storage qualification and the NVMe model/link/NUMA gates (lines 139-160). A failure in any of these is recorded in campaign-status.json under operation 'gpu-tests-3', misattributing the failing phase.
findings.requested_change: Set operation = 'fixture' / 'qualification-<media>' / 'nvme-topology-gate' before those blocks so partial_not_accepted records name the actual failing step.

findings.evidence: status.json cites host_test_receipt junit-fixed.xml (0.47 s).
